description: Chat from a self-described courier sends an APK named as a parcel photo and coaches the recipient to allow unknown sources and grant SMS permission.
rationale: A "photo" delivered as an Android app, instructions to bypass install warnings and grant SMS access, plus a return-the-parcel threat, is a known mobile banking-malware lure.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
